answer: The wharf customs crate seal: a newcomer's first three jobs are sealed in crates, opened only when the paying client and a randomly drawn customs inspector both co-sign the work was real, each staking 3 POA; crates wait frozen on the tundra terrace until both keys turn, so copied work is caught at the gate. The nth identity from one wallet seals n crates at once, posting 4n-squared POA (1st 4, 10th 400, 1,540 across ten); one operator cannot open ten crates at once.
